mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the prior month signals an easing monetary policy stance that reduces discount rates for equity valuation, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances where FEDFUNDS declines over the prior month, or Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window falls below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly unemployment rate exceeding 6.0% signals deteriorating labor market conditions that reduce consumer spending power and corporate earnings growth, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where UNRATE exceeds 6.0%, or Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window falls below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicate broad-based consumer demand contraction that triggers corporate revenue revisions downward, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where both HOUST and RSAFS decline, or Rank IC for the interaction signal over any 3-year window falls below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production falling below 104.0 indicates manufacturing slowdown that increases input costs and reduces corporate margins, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where INDPRO < 104.0, or Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window falls below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Year-over-year CPI inflation exceeding 2.5% signals persistent inflation that may trigger monetary tightening, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where CPIAUCSL YoY > 2.5%, or Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window falls below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in real retail sales (RSAFS) over the prior quarter indicates strong consumer spending that supports corporate revenue growth, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances where RSAFS increases, or Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window falls below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in employment (PAYEMS) and increases in unemployment (UNRATE) signal severe labor market contraction that reduces household income and consumer confidence, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where PAYEMS declines and UNRATE rises, or Rank IC for the interaction signal over any 3-year window falls below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: GDP growth rate below 1.0% annualized signals slowing economic activity that reduces corporate earnings expectations, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where GDPC1 growth rate < 1.0% annualized, or Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window falls below 0.03.
